other.tags: Synthwave with heavy outrun and retrowave influences. A side-chained analog synth bass plays a driving eighth-note pattern. The lead melody features a detuned sawtooth synth with a short portamento and heavy chorus effect. Drums consist of a gated reverb snare and a punchy 707-style kick. Arpeggiated minor triads in a high-register square wave synth provide harmonic movement. A resonant low-pass filter sweep occurs every eight bars on a lush polyphonic pad. Key of C minor. 115 BPM. 4/4 time signature.

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted kick drum with a long, saturated sub-tail hits on every quarter note at 130 BPM in the key of F minor. A high-pass filtered white noise riser sweeps upward over four bars. Metallic percussion hits with short decay occur on the off-beats. A resonant, low-frequency synth pulse oscillates with a sawtooth waveform, modulated by a rhythmic low-frequency oscillator. Gritty, bit-crushed textures layer over the mid-range frequencies. The track maintains a constant 4/4 time signature with no melodic shifts. A sharp, percussive synth pluck with heavy delay repeats a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern. The arrangement features a sudden low-pass filter sweep that cuts all frequencies above 200Hz before snapping back to full bandwidth.

drums.tags: Indie rock with a lo-fi aesthetic. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated four-chord progression using palm-muted eighth notes. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar with a rounded, warm tone. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a steady kick drum pattern with occasional eighth-note fills on the rack tom. A second electric guitar enters with a bright, jangly tone playing melodic lead lines in the upper register. The tempo is 112 BPM in the key of G Major and 4/4 time signature.

vocals.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar progression with a heavily overdriven tone. Drums feature a high-tempo d-beat pattern with a prominent, dry snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The recording has a lo-fi, DIY aesthetic with high-frequency saturation and a narrow stereo field. Tempo is 180 BPM. Key is E minor. 4/4 time signature.
